digest.component_or_area: LLM capability detection and provider routing
propositions: Capability decisions currently made by string-matching provider names (anthropic prefix, bedrock prefix) fail for Bedrock-hosted Claude because the model string says bedrock not anthropic, silently disabling caching and forcing prompted output

A new leaf module capabilities.py must replace string-based routing with profile-based detection, deriving native_structured_output, prompt_cache_style, and supports_thinking from ModelProfile fields rather than provider name strings

capabilities_for() must accept both model objects (reading .profile directly) and lazy model strings (resolving profiles without constructing providers via _PROFILE_RESOLVERS registry), enabling capability detection for deferred providers like openai and google without importing their SDKs

A rebar override table (_REBAR_OVERRIDES) must force native_structured_output=False for Claude on both Anthropic and Bedrock hosts by reading profile type and capability fields, not provider names, overriding upstream's json_schema capability because pydantic-ai routes it unsafely for rebar's use case

cache_settings_for(prompt_cache_style) must replace the deleted _anthropic_cache_settings helper with a single dispatching function that returns AnthropicModelSettings for anthropic style, BedrockModelSettings for bedrock style, and None for no caching

The change must preserve all existing behavior for currently-shipping providers (anthropic, openai, google) via _PROFILE_RESOLVERS enumerating all prefixes rebar emits, must add no new runtime dependency (boto3/bedrock is S3 scope), and must degrade unknown profiles conservatively (prompted output, no cache) with exactly one warning
